name: Tinker: beacons are immune to crowd control and knockback (#12128)
contract: Shield, Restorative, Replenishment and Alarm Beacons (50036, 51036, 53036, 54036, 55036, 56036, 50037,
500360, 500361) had CreatureImmunitiesId 0, so enemies could stun, fear and knock them away (the report).
The user approved immunity set -410 on 2026-11-14: crowd-control mechanics plus the knockback and pull
effects 98/124/144/145. Creature::InitEntry loads the template immunities, so a summoned beacon must be
immune to Hammer of Justice 853 (stun), Fear 5782 and Typhoon's knockback effect 61391/0. A plain
creature 299 (no template immunities) stays affected by all three, proving the probes discriminate.
